name: analyze-stock-kpi-demo
description: Dev-only npm metadata for the ui/ dashboard. Vite build (ui/ = source, ui/dist = deployable), Vitest unit harness, ESLint + Prettier, and TypeScript for JSDoc type-checking. The dashboard ships zero runtime JS deps — Chart.js and Fuse.js are vendored under public/vendor/ and loaded as script-tag globals.
